ideas.name: any warning against the day's direction
ideas.why: a turn called against where the session has gone since its open: the counter-drift turn #1/#2 point to

ideas.name: any warning against the last hour's slope
ideas.why: the same, with the drift as the last 60 minutes' move

ideas.name: any warning against the 5m EMA's slope
ideas.why: the same, with the drift as the 5m-equivalent EMA (EMA 105 on 1m bars) sloping over 15 minutes

ideas.name: any warning against a steep VWAP slope
ideas.why: if #2 is about drift, it should be stronger when VWAP moved over half a 5m ATR in 15 minutes
